items.briefing:
Australian authorities have arrested two individuals allegedly linked to the hacking group "TeamPCP," a reminder that cybercrime enforcement is active locally. Separately, a threat group tracked as TA4922 is running tax-themed phishing campaigns using malware called PackClient — Australian staff should be alert to suspicious emails claiming to be from the ATO or related to tax matters, as these can lead to serious system compromise.

**Practical tip:** If you receive an unexpected email about a tax refund, debt, or ATO notice, don't click any links — go directly to ato.gov.au to verify.

featured.title: TrendAI tops CyberGym with 97% exploit-remediation rate
featured.summary: Enterprises could cut their exposure window as TrendAI's AESIR scored 97% on an independent benchmark against confirmed software flaws.
